lane: Interactive Canvas gameplay effect; no new character or cinematic animation
intent: Grand Puff announces where he will jump or charge, visibly commits there, then attacks it.
sources: One generated purple vortex with owner-authorized alpha extraction for the jump and an opaque painted swatch for charge streams; existing approved dust puff for charge crests/front. Unchanged approved boss jump/flinch sprites and counter assets.
anchors: Projected immutable hit geometry and boss floor sampled on each warning entry; marker/rail origins owned by the encounter adapter; Canvas behind actors.

timeline.jump: Painted round purple vortex rotates 1.5 turns while moving from boss to fixed destination and growing to final footprint.
timeline.charge: Two tapered painted streams extend; two painted dust crests unfold sequentially between them; a broad dust front gathers at the advancing end. No endpoint vortex.
timeline.lock: Fixed geometry, three local brightness pulses; third flash shifts paint and boundary from purple to coral-peach before launch.
timeline.launch: Warning stays steadily warm; authored boss jump/charge reaches existing committed destination.

interrupts: Encounter pause freezes the shared attack clock; exit frees Canvas; subsequent attack resets the sampled origin. First learning hold waits at arrival until Roshan leaves the danger area.
authority: Effects grant no input, reward or damage. Existing pattern/encounter controller owns targets, strikes, assistance and saves.
fallback: Geometry and actual attacks remain valid independently of the visual renderer.
readability: Minimum 2.2s warning; bounded local flashes, no full-screen flash, no blank hazard interval; 30Hz effects. Review circle and charge at 1280x720 and 1560x720.

acceptance.machine: Final exact Godot 4.7.2 scripts/ci.sh exit 0 and ALL OK (tmp/puff-front-full-ci.log); focused boss and static/audit/2D gates pass. Earlier rough-draft Opera exit 127 remains historical, superseded by this full final-candidate pass.
acceptance.visual: Owner accepts jump basics; charge-end swirl rejected at 3.5/5. Revised extending-wave pattern and coral-peach third flash under live verification; final 4.75/5 target remains unawarded.

supersedes: v2 dust warning presentation only; other v2 response effects retained.

source_bindings.effects: scripts/dust_boss_telegraph_2d.gd and scripts/encounter_warning_cue_2d.gd; exact LF-normalized hashes in impact record
source_bindings.retained_art: grand_puff_storybook_cues_v2.json source_art and grand_puff_encounter_clips_v1.json character bindings remain unchanged; no new authored character pose.

style_brief.jump: Painted purple dust vortex, projected onto the floor; grouped rounded curls replace diagram strokes. Travel and lock timing unchanged.
style_brief.charge: Paint-textured tapered streams, two unfolding painted dust crests and a broad dust front. Charge-end vortex rejected by owner at 3.5/5 and removed.
style_brief.hierarchy: Boss and Roshan remain clear; one warning event at a time; purple attacks distinct from gold counters. No new tutorial panel or reward-like stars.
style_brief.mobile: One 512px POT mipmapped effect texture; 30Hz effects, bounded explicit strip quads, no accumulating particles or new 3D debt.
style_brief.source: Native painted vortex from built-in imagegen; owner approved local alpha extraction. One 512px RGBA asset supplies the jump icon and an opaque paint swatch for the streams; no vortex icon at the charge end.
